description: Returns one AnimatedWebs UI library component by id: description, runtime, interaction, tags, every variant with live URL and thumbnail, import name, shadcn install command, and with include_source true its complete source code (Pro). Use it after search_catalog (kind components) to inspect a component and then add it to a project; use generate_component instead when nothing in the library fits. Details never spend a credit. include_source needs AnimatedWebs Pro (others get an error with the pricing link) and returns code: the renderer and shared files with a per-account watermark, filling about 120,000 characters; files that did not fit have no code and are named in code.omitted, so call again with that path to get one file. New components count toward a fair-use cap (40 per 10 minutes, 150 a day, 500 a week, shared with get_background) that never blocks one already opened today. Unknown ids return an error. Example: {"id":"aurora-hero","include_source":true}.

id.description: Component id exactly as returned by search_catalog (kind components), e.g. 'aurora-hero'.

include_source.description: true adds code with the source files (Pro only). Default false: public details only.

path.description: One file path from code.files or code.omitted of an earlier call for the same id; returns only that file in code.files. Implies include_source.

name: get_component

assets.description: Asset list from the source bundle

code.description: Missing when the file did not fit; fetch it with path

shared.description: Shared helper used by several components

omitted.description: Paths without code in this reply

source.description: pro: full source available with AnimatedWebs Pro; none: no source bundle

title: Get an AnimatedWebs UI component
